name: Paperclip AI
author: Cory Blische
description: Set up, run and monitor PaperclipAI: guided npx setup, start/stop, logs, health, adapter logins and optional private tailnet serve.

barWidget.description: PaperclipAI service status with a keyboard-driven panel

schema.label: API URL
schema.description: Base URL of the PaperclipAI server. The panel reads <url>/api/health.

schema.label: systemd user unit
schema.description: User service to monitor, start, stop and tail logs for.

schema.label: Tailnet HTTPS port
schema.description: HTTPS port on your tailnet hostname used by `tailscale serve` when Tailscale is running. Only this port's serve config is changed.
